items.title: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM
items.summary: We're honored that Microsoft has once again been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).The post Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM  appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Rob Lefferts
